query:
SELECT 
  YEAR(saleDate) as year,
  MONTH(saleDate) as month,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(finalAmount) as total
FROM sales 
WHERE saleType = 'DELIVERY'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (
    (YEAR(saleDate) = 2024 AND MONTH(saleDate) = 12)
    OR (YEAR(saleDate) = 2025 AND MONTH(saleDate) = 12)
    OR (YEAR(saleDate) = 2026 AND MONTH(saleDate) = 1)
  )
GROUP BY YEAR(saleDate), MONTH(saleDate)
ORDER BY year, month
